name: strip
description: A status line with where you are and how you run: folder, git branch, model, effort, permission mode, context fill and session cost.

showBranch.title: Show git branch
showBranch.description: The current branch after the folder, with * when there are uncommitted changes.

showContext.title: Show context fill
showContext.description: How full the context window is.

showCost.title: Show session cost
showCost.description: Spend so far this session, where the account reports it.

pollSeconds.title: Refresh interval (seconds)
pollSeconds.description: How often branch, context and cost are re-read between turns.
